[title] Survey Results Summary statistics Quantiles and boxplots Python/Colab Outlook Recap from Lecture 1a
[body] • Two categories of uncertainty: aleatory and epistemic • Visualize distributions via histograms and scattegrams • Measures of location: mean, median, mode • Measures of dispersion: range, variance, standard deviation, coefficient of variation
[body] Prof. Oke (UMass Amherst) CEE 260/MIE 273 M1b: Summarizing Data September 10, 2026 3 / 16
